# Links — Mike Odnis

> High-throughput, security-verified URL shortener and click analytics platform at https://links.mikeodnis.dev, part of Mike Odnis's Live Console ecosystem (mikeodnis.dev).

Links shortens URLs into cryptographically unbiased 7-character Base62 codes (or custom aliases), verifies every destination through a 6-stage security pipeline before creation or edit, serves single-hop `302 Found` redirects through a multi-tier L1 LRU + Upstash Redis cache-aside layer, and records privacy-first batched click analytics without storing raw IP addresses.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/): Overview of public verified short links, platform status, and Live Console navigation.
- [Create Short Link](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/create): Shorten and security-verify a URL with optional custom alias and expiration date.
- [Sign In / Register](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/auth): Authenticate to manage personal links, view analytics, and issue hashed `sk_` API keys.

## Technical & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Full LLM Reference](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete architecture, API contracts, security pipeline, privacy guarantees, and SLOs.
- [Operational Health & Telemetry](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/api/health): Readiness probes (Hasura + Redis) and live redirect latency (`p50`/`p95`/`p99`) & cache-hit snapshot.
- [URL Security Verifier](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/api/security/verify): 6-stage URL safety verification (syntax/SSRF, DNS, SSL, redirect chains, phishing heuristics, malware).
- [Dynamic OpenGraph Card API](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/api/og): Live Console `1200x630` PNG social preview cards.
- [PWA Manifest](https://links.mikeodnis.dev/manifest.webmanifest): Installable standalone web app metadata with `share_target` support.

## Ecosystem (Mike Odnis)

- [Portfolio](https://mikeodnis.dev): Engineering portfolio, projects, and live telemetry console.
- [Platform API](https://api.mikeodnis.dev): Polyglot API platform (Bun + Elysia Core, Go Media/R2, Hasura GraphQL).
- [Edge CDN](https://cdn.mikeodnis.dev): Hexagonal TypeScript Cloudflare Workers + R2 CDN.
- [Source Code (Apache-2.0)](https://github.com/WomB0ComB0/link-shortener): Open-source Nuxt 4 + Nitro + TypeScript repository.
